concepts.summary: 在任意非退化三角形中，边长与对角正弦成比例。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 使用 $a/\sin A=b/\sin B=c/\sin C$，大写角对应同名小写对边。先检查是否已有已知角及其对边。

en.title: Law of Sines and notation
en.summary: In any nondegenerate triangle, side length s are proportional to the sines of their opposite angle s.

method.title: Method
method.body: Use $a/\sin A=b/\sin B=c/\sin C$; each lowercase side is opposite its uppercase angle. First identify a known angle and its known opposite side.

concepts.title: AAS与ASA三角形
concepts.summary: 两角一边确定唯一三角形，条件是两个角的和小于180°。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先用内角和求第三角，再用正弦定理逐边计算；只给AAA无法确定尺度。

en.title: AAS and ASA triangle s
en.summary: Two angle s and a side determine one triangle, provided the angle sum is less than 180°.

method.title: Method
method.body: Find the third angle using the angle sum, then each side with the Law of Sines. AAA alone does not set the scale.

concepts.title: SSA的零、一、二解
concepts.summary: 已知角及其对边和另一边时必须检查所有候选角。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 计算 $k=b\sin A/a$。$k>1$ 无解；否则候选 $B=\sin^{-1}k$、$180^\circ-\sin^{-1}k$，仅保留 $A+B<180^\circ$。$B=90^\circ$ 只计一次，退化零角排除。

pitfalls: 锐角A时，用高 $h=b\sin A$ 比较a：小于h无解，等于h一直角解，h<a<b两解，a≥b一解；钝角A时须a>b才一解。

en.title: Zero, one or two SSA solutions
en.summary: Given an angle, its opposite side and another side, test every candidate angle.

method.title: Method
method.body: Compute $k=b\sin A/a$. If $k>1$ there is no triangle; otherwise test $B=\sin^{-1}k$ and $180^\circ-\sin^{-1}k$, retaining only $A+B<180^\circ$. Count 90° once and exclude zero-angle degeneracy.

pitfalls: For acute A, comparea with $h=b\sin A$: belowh gives 0, equalh gives 1 right triangle, h<a<b gives 2, and a≥b gives 1. For obtuse A, exactly 1 requiresa>b.

concepts.title: 方位角与测量
concepts.summary: 方位 NθE 等从正北或正南朝东西量锐角。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先画南北东西及旅行路径，再把方位角转换为三角形内角；最短距离是到航线的垂线段。

en.title: Bearings and surveying
en.summary: Bearings such as NθE measure an acute angle from north or south toward east or west.

method.title: Method
method.body: Draw compass axes and the travel path, convert bearings to interior angle s, and find shortest distance with a perpendicular to the course.

exercises.prompt: Mollweide公式：证明 $(b-c)/a=\sin((B-C)/2)/\cos(A/2)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 由正弦定理设 $a=k\sin A,b=k\sin B,c=k\sin C$，$k>0$。所以 $(b-c)/a=(\sin B-\sin C)/\sin A$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 和差化积：$\sin B-\sin C=2\cos((B+C)/2)\sin((B-C)/2)$。由 $B+C=180^\circ-A$，该余弦为 $\sin(A/2)$；又 $\sin A=2\sin(A/2)\cos(A/2)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 约去正数 $2\sin(A/2)$，得到所证公式；$0<A/2<90^\circ$ 保证余弦分母不为零。

en.prompt: Mollweide’s formula: In triangle ABC prove $(b-c)/a=\sin((B-C)/2)/\cos(A/2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: By the Law of Sines let $a=k\sin A,b=k\sin B,c=k\sin C$, $k>0$. Thus $(b-c)/a=(\sin B-\sin C)/\sin A$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Sum-to-product gives $\sin B-\sin C=2\cos((B+C)/2)\sin((B-C)/2)$. Since $B+C=180^\circ-A$, the cosine is $\sin(A/2)$, while $\sin A=2\sin(A/2)\cos(A/2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Cancel positive $2\sin(A/2)$ to obtain the formula. Since $0<A/2<90^\circ$, the cosine denominator is nonzero.

exercises.prompt: Mollweide公式：证明 $(b+c)/a=\cos((B-C)/2)/\sin(A/2)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 正弦定理给出 $(b+c)/a=(\sin B+\sin C)/\sin A$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 和差化积及内角和给出 $\sin B+\sin C=2\sin((B+C)/2)\cos((B-C)/2)=2\cos(A/2)\cos((B-C)/2)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 再用 $\sin A=2\sin(A/2)\cos(A/2)$，约去正的 $2\cos(A/2)$，得所证公式；$\sin(A/2)>0$。

en.prompt: Mollweide’s formula: In triangle ABC prove $(b+c)/a=\cos((B-C)/2)/\sin(A/2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The Law of Sines gives $(b+c)/a=(\sin B+\sin C)/\sin A$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Sum-to-product and the angle sum give $\sin B+\sin C=2\sin((B+C)/2)\cos((B-C)/2)=2\cos(A/2)\cos((B-C)/2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Use $\sin A=2\sin(A/2)\cos(A/2)$ and cancel positive $2\cos(A/2)$. This yields the formula, with $\sin(A/2)>0$.

exercises.prompt: 正切定理：在三角形ABC中证明 $(b-c)/(b+c)=\tan((B-C)/2)/\tan((B+C)/2)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 正弦定理给出 $(b-c)/(b+c)=(\sin B-\sin C)/(\sin B+\sin C)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 将正弦余弦比写成正切，得结论。因为 $0<(B+C)/2<90^\circ$、$|(B-C)/2|<90^\circ$，所有所用分母均非零。

en.prompt: Law of Tangents: In triangle ABC prove $(b-c)/(b+c)=\tan((B-C)/2)/\tan((B+C)/2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The Law of Sines gives $(b-c)/(b+c)=(\sin B-\sin C)/(\sin B+\sin C)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Apply sum-to-product to get $[2\cos((B+C)/2)\sin((B-C)/2)]/[2\sin((B+C)/2)\cos((B-C)/2)]$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Write sine/cosine ratios as tangents to obtain the result. Since $0<(B+C)/2<90^\circ$ and $|(B-C)/2|<90^\circ$, all denominators used are nonzero.

exercises.prompt: 三角形两边长为 $\sqrt3+1$ 英尺和 $\sqrt3-1$ 英尺，夹角60°。用正切定理（习题121）求另两角的差。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 令大边对角为B、小边对角为C，则 $B+C=120^\circ$，且 $(b-c)/(b+c)=2/(2\sqrt3)=1/\sqrt3$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 正切定理给出 $1/\sqrt3=\tan((B-C)/2)/\tan60^\circ$，所以 $\tan((B-C)/2)=1$。因 $0<(B-C)/2<60^\circ$，故 $B-C=90^\circ$。

en.prompt: Two side s of a triangle are $\sqrt3+1$ feet and $\sqrt3-1$ feet, with included angle 60°. Use the Law of Tangents (Exercise 121) to find the difference of the remaining angle s.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Let B oppose the longer side and C the shorter. Then $B+C=120^\circ$ and $(b-c)/(b+c)=2/(2\sqrt3)=1/\sqrt3$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The Law of Tangents gives $1/\sqrt3=\tan((B-C)/2)/\tan60^\circ$, so $\tan((B-C)/2)=1$. With $0<(B-C)/2<60^\circ$, obtain $B-C=90^\circ$.

exercises.prompt: 给三角形ABC最具体的描述并说明理由：$a\sin A=b\sin B$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 正弦定理给出 $\sin A=a/k,\sin B=b/k$，其中 $k>0$。代入条件得 $a^2/k=b^2/k$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 由于边长正，$a=b$，所以A=B，三角形以c为底边是等腰三角形（可能为等边）。

en.prompt: Give the most specific description of triangle ABC and explain: $a\sin A=b\sin B$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The Law of Sines gives $\sin A=a/k,\sin B=b/k$ with $k>0$. Substituting yields $a^2/k=b^2/k$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Positive side length s imply $a=b$, hence A=B. The triangle is isosceles with basec, possibly equilateral.

en.answer: Isosceles with a=b and A=B (possibly equilateral).

exercises.prompt: 给三角形ABC最具体的描述并说明理由：$a\cos A=b\cos B$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 以 $a=k\sin A,b=k\sin B$ 代入，得 $\sin A\cos A=\sin B\cos B$，即 $\sin2A=\sin2B$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 等价地，$\sin2A-\sin2B=2\cos(A+B)\sin(A-B)=0$。三角形中 $|A-B|<180^\circ$，故 $\sin(A-B)=0$ 仅给A=B；另一支 $\cos(A+B)=0$ 给 $A+B=90^\circ$，即C=90°。

exercises.answer: A=B的等腰三角形，或C=90°的直角三角形（两类可重叠）。

en.prompt: Give the most specific description of triangle ABC and explain: $a\cos A=b\cos B$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Substitute $a=k\sin A,b=k\sin B$ to obtain $\sin A\cos A=\sin B\cos B$, or $\sin2A=\sin2B$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Equivalently, $\sin2A-\sin2B=2\cos(A+B)\sin(A-B)=0$. Since $|A-B|<180^\circ$, the sine factor gives A=B. The other factor gives $A+B=90^\circ$, hence C=90°.

en.answer: Isosceles with A=B, or a right triangle with C=90°; these classes can overlap.

exercises.prompt: 用正弦定理证明任何等腰三角形有两个相等角。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 若a=b，正弦定理给出 $\sin A=\sin B$。在0°与180°之间，这意味着A=B或A+B=180°。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 第二种会使C=0°，与非退化三角形冲突。因此A=B。

en.prompt: Use the Law of Sines to show that any isosceles triangle has two equal angle s.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: If a=b, the Law of Sines gives $\sin A=\sin B$. Between 0° and 180° this implies A=B or A+B=180°.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The second case gives C=0°, contradicting a nondegenerate triangle. Therefore A=B.

en.answer: The angle s opposite the equal side s are equal.

exercises.prompt: 用正弦定理证明任何有两个相等角的三角形为等腰三角形。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 设A=B，则正弦定理 $a/\sin A=b/\sin B$ 的两个分母相同且为正。乘以该正数得a=b。

exercises.answer: 等角所对边相等，故为等腰三角形。

en.prompt: Use the Law of Sines to show that any triangle with two equal angle s is isosceles.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Let A=B. The denominators of $a/\sin A=b/\sin B$ are equal and positive. Multiply by that value to obtaina=b.

en.answer: The opposite side s are equal, so the triangle is isosceles.
